Elapsum

Days since. Days until. Periods with both ends counted.

Built to replace the Android app "Days Counter" after it was pulled from Google Play — the whole point of a self-hosted app is that it can't be taken away. No account, no cloud: everything lives in your phone's own storage, fully offline once installed.

Imports backups from the original Days Counter app, plus Elapsum's own exports. Other apps' formats are not supported.
